_comment: A trimmed Legacy Fabric launcher profile, as meta.legacyfabric.net/v2/versions/loader/1.8.9/<loader>/profile/json returns it: inheritsFrom 1.8.9, a Knot main class, and libraries published as Maven coordinates plus a repository url rather than Mojang-style downloads. The guava entry is deliberately a newer version of one vanilla also ships, to exercise classpath shadowing; the LWJGL pair is copied verbatim from the real 1.8.9 profile, and lwjgl-platform is the natives-only case that has no plain jar in Maven at all.
